newsitem.title: GERMANY: HBG to fully take over Wayss&Freytag - paper.
newsitem.headline: HBG to fully take over Wayss&Freytag - paper.

text.p: FRANKFURT, May 10 Reuter) - Dutch construction firm Hollandse Beton Groep (HBG) is planning to fully take over its German Wayss & Freytag unit, the German financial newspaper Boersen Zeitung said on Saturday.
But HBG chairman Jan Veraart told the paper that the unit, of which HBG currently owns 74 percent, would remain a German company within a European group.

"We are in no hurry, but we are seeking in the long term to fully take over Wayss & Freytag," Veraart said. Wayss & Freytag shares are also 10-percent held by insurance firm Colonia Nordstern and five-percent held by BHF-Bank.

Veraart also said he expected that by 1998, Wayss & Freytag would no longer be posting losses. In 1996, the unit recorded a loss of more than 90 million marks due to the recession in Germany's construction industry.
Veraart said the integration of Wayss & Freytag would take two to three years and would bring numerous synergy benefits.
